name: Charlie Baseball Cap
construction: Real sizes 54/56/58/60 cm plus a strap with a metal buckle · low rounded crown · pre-curved brim
fit_note: #1 pick. The only one in real sizes: take the 60 and fine-tune with the strap. The quietest logo, classy with everything.

name: Vintage Micro Logo Hat
construction: One size, up to 61.5 cm · 5-panel smooth front that holds its shape · snap back · 65% cotton
fit_note: #2. The best shape on thick hair, with plenty of room. Only downsides: plastic snap and some polyester.

name: Yankees Franchise LS Cap
construction: Fitted sizes S–XXL (XL 60–62 cm, XXL 62–63 cm) · relaxed rounded crown · curved visor · closed back
fit_note: #3. The Yankees cap you wanted, in a size that fits. No strap, so measure your head and pick the size exactly (between two: take the bigger).

name: Yankees Ballpark Hat
construction: One size, about 61.5 cm · soft washed-cotton 6-panel · antique brass buckle strap
fit_note: #4. Yankees with a buckle like your Western; softer, so it sits a little flatter.

name: Yankees Merino Wool 9TWENTY
construction: One size, up to 60.6 cm · soft wool · curved visor · strap
fit_note: #6. Good-value winter option, but at its limit if your head is 60 cm or more.

name: Core Logo Hat
construction: One size (ALD usually 61.5 cm+, not stated) · soft cotton-twill 6-panel · antique brass buckle strap
fit_note: #5. The quiet twin of the Yankees Ballpark: crisper, darker navy and a small wordmark.

name: Washed Script Chino Hat
construction: One size, up to 64 cm · soft washed chino · brass buckle strap
fit_note: #7. The most room of all; the red script picks up your burgundy Sambas but shows more.

name: Madison Logo Cap
fit_note: #8. Lots of room for little money, but the front sits taller and it's more workwear than classy.
